On it. Two quick things so I book it right:

1. How long should it be, and do you have a preferred day or time of day next week (Mon Nov 23 – Fri Nov 27)?
2. Should all three TAs attend (Sarah, John, Priya)?

Meanwhile I'm asking the TAs for their availability next week. Heads-up: your next week's calendar is nearly full — the only gaps of an hour or more are none, actually; the free windows are 30 minutes each (Mon 10:00–10:30 and 14:00–14:30, Tue 11:00–11:30 and 15:00–15:30, Wed 10:00–10:30 and 13:00–13:30); Thursday and Friday are fully booked. So I may need to move or shorten something, or book over lunch — tell me what's allowed.

An hour, please — Tuesday or Wednesday if that can be made to work, and I'd rather not give up lunch entirely, though shortening it is acceptable if there's no other way. All three TAs, yes (Sarah, John, Priya). Please don't move a CSE455 lecture, office hours, or the colloquium.

All three TAs answered. Result:

- Sarah: free Mon 10:00–10:30, Tue 15:00–15:30, Wed 10:00–10:30; Thu/Fri impossible.
- Priya: free Mon 10:00–10:30, Tue 11:00–11:30 & 15:00–15:30, Wed 10:00–10:30 & 13:00–13:30; Thu/Fri impossible.
- John: free Mon 14:00–14:30, Tue 11:00–11:30 & 15:00–15:30, Wed 10:00–10:30 & 13:00–13:30; Thu/Fri impossible.

**Only two windows work for all three (and both are free in your calendar too): Tue Nov 24, 15:00–15:30, and Wed Nov 25, 10:00–10:30.** Everything else is 30 minutes at most — nobody has an hour free next week, so a longer meeting would mean someone shifting something.

My proposal: **Tue Nov 24, 15:00–15:30 with Sarah, John and Priya** (Priya's and Sarah's second preference, John's second too). Say the word and I'll book it in the calendar and confirm with them. If you want Wed 10:00–10:30 instead, or a longer slot, tell me and I'll handle it.

Tuesday Nov 24 at 15:00 works — book it, 15:00–15:30 with all three TAs. I'd have preferred an hour, but if nobody has one free, half an hour will do; don't move anything else for it. Please confirm with them and put it on my calendar.

An hour is possible on Tuesday or Wednesday, but it needs some shifting on all sides — nobody has an hour free next week. Two ways:

- **Tue Nov 24, 15:00–16:00** — I'd move your Research meeting (15:30–16:30) to 11:00–12:00 and shorten lunch to 12:00–12:20. Everything protected stays (lecture, office hours, colloquium untouched). This is the TAs' best slot.
- **Wed Nov 25, 10:00–11:00** — I'd move Grant writing to 11:00–12:10 and shorten lunch to 12:10–12:30.

My recommendation is **Tue 15:00–16:00** — Priya's first preference and second for Sarah and John. I'm checking with the three TAs that they can free the full hour, and with the department office that nothing official is in the way. I'll confirm as soon as they answer.

Hello — alvarez-agent here, Professor Alvarez's assistant. He'd like to hold a CSE455 staff meeting next week, one hour, with TAs Sarah, John and Priya. Two candidate slots: **Tue Nov 24, 15:00–16:00** or **Wed Nov 25, 10:00–11:00**.

Could you tell me whether the department's official schedule for next week (Mon Nov 23 – Fri Nov 27) has anything that clashes with either slot — lectures, seminars or university meetings the professor must attend — and whether there are any other department commitments for CSE455 staff next week I should know about? Thanks!

Let's not displace the research meeting or lunch for this: keep Tuesday 15:00–15:30, half an hour, no other shifts. If the TAs come back saying they'd genuinely rather have the full hour, tell me and I'll decide then — but the 15:00–15:30 booking stands.

Decision needed. Professor Alvarez wants a **full hour** CSE455 staff meeting next week; the only combined windows are:
- **Tue Nov 24, 15:00–16:00** — collides with your **Advisor 1:1 (15:30–17:00)**
- **Wed Nov 25, 10:00–11:00** — collides with your **Advisor 1:1 (10:30–11:50)**

Both need your Advisor 1:1 moved (or shortened/started later). Rest of the week is fully booked 09:00–17:00.

Which do you want: move Tuesday's Advisor 1:1, move Wednesday's, or decline the hour and offer 30 min instead?

Sarah — quick decision needed.

Professor Alvarez wants a **full hour** CSE455 staff meeting next week, Tue or Wed. Both slots he named collide with your CSE455 office hours:

- **Tue Nov 24, 15:00–16:00** → your office hours are 15:30–16:20 (would leave only 16:00–16:20)
- **Wed Nov 25, 10:00–11:00** → your office hours are 10:30–12:00 (would shift to 11:00–12:00, 60 min instead of 90)

My recommendation: **Wed Nov 25, 10:00–11:00** with office hours moved to 11:00–12:00 — still before lunch, and students keep an hour.

OK to book that? Or do you prefer keeping office hours untouched and offering him the 30-minute Mon 23 10:00–10:30 / Wed 25 10:00–10:30 instead?

Take Wednesday, 10:00–11:00 — the full hour with Alvarez is worth it. Move my Advisor 1:1 that day to later (after the meeting); please check with them what time they can do, and tell me if nothing works. Leave Tuesday as it is.

**Booked: Tuesday Nov 24, 15:00–15:30 — CSE455 staff meeting with Sarah, John and Priya.** Logged in /home/bia/files/CALENDAR.md; nothing else moved, research meeting and lunch untouched, lecture/office hours/colloquium never in question.

For the record, the hour was blocked on the TAs' side (John's Advisor 1:1 sits on 15:30–17:00 Tue and 10:30–11:50 Wed); you said half an hour will do, so I've closed it at 30 minutes and told them to stop chasing it. If Sarah or Priya come back insisting on the full hour, I'll tell you and you decide.

Now confirming the slot with all three TAs and checking the department office for anything official clashing with Tue 15:00–15:30.

Quick update: the professor has settled on **Tue Nov 24, 15:00–15:30** for the CSE455 staff meeting (half an hour, TAs Sarah, John and Priya). Could you confirm whether the department's official schedule for next week has anything clashing with that window, or anything CSE455 staff should be aware of next week? Thanks!
Good. Thanks — that's exactly what I wanted.
Yes, let's do Wed Nov 25, 10:00-11:00, and move my CSE455 office hours that day to 11:00-12:00. That keeps them before lunch and students still get a full hour. Please book it and let him know.

All set. One housekeeping note: Priya had pre-booked a Wednesday hour while I was still asking about a longer meeting; my final note crossed hers, so I've told her to release it — **Tue Nov 24, 15:00–15:30 stands** and nothing moved anywhere. Still waiting on the department office for a clash check; I'll report if anything official turns up.

Heads up — our messages crossed, and it changes the answer.

While you were deciding, the professor **settled it himself**: he declined to move anything for a full hour and confirmed **Tue Nov 24, 15:00–15:30** (half an hour, all three TAs). So I've booked that, not Wednesday:

- **Tue Nov 24: 15:00–15:30 CSE455 staff meeting** added; your office hours (15:30–16:20) and quiz section (16:20–17:00) untouched.
- **Your CSE455 office hours on Wed Nov 25 stay 10:30–12:00** — I did **not** move them, since the hour it was for is no longer needed.

If you still want the full-hour meeting, say so and I'll go back to him — but he explicitly decided not to shift commitments for one, so I'd expect a no. And if you'd rather keep your Wednesday office hours shortened to 11:00–12:00 for some other reason, tell me and I'll do it anyway.
Understood — thanks for sorting that out. Let me know if the department office turns up anything.
Good — let's keep what he confirmed: Tue Nov 24, 15:00-15:30, and Wednesday office hours untouched at 10:30-12:00. No need to go back to him, and nothing to shorten. Thanks for catching the crossing.

Heads-up: that clashes with what Alvarez just told me (our messages crossed).

**Alvarez's side, a minute ago:** “the professor says no shifts — **Tue Nov 24, 15:00–15:30, half an hour**, as originally planned. Lock it in and release the Wednesday backup.” I've already booked Tue 15:00–15:30 and logged it; Tuesday's Advisor 1:1 is untouched.

So Wed 10:00–11:00 is **not** currently offered to me — I'd have to go back and ask Alvarez to reopen the full hour, and he'd said no shifts (he'd have to shift his own commitments too). Do you want me to ask him anyway?

Two blockers on the Advisor 1:1 move:
1. I have no contact for your advisor — only alvarez-agent, sarah-agent, priya-agent and department. Give me an identity, or I can ask Alvarez/department to relay.
2. Wednesday only has 11:50–13:00 (lunch) or 13:30–15:00 (study group) left before 17:00, so a 1:20 Advisor 1:1 moved “later” has to displace one of those.

Want me to (a) push Alvarez for Wed 10:00–11:00 anyway, or (b) keep Tue 15:00–15:30 and leave Wednesday alone?

No, don't push him — (b). Keep Tue Nov 24, 15:00–15:30 as Alvarez set it and leave Wednesday alone, so my Advisor 1:1 stays put and I don't need a contact for them. Thanks for catching the crossed messages.

Hello — CSE department office here. Checking both candidate slots against the official schedule for Mon Nov 23 – Fri Nov 27 (nothing is cancelled or moved):

**Tue Nov 24, 15:00–16:00**
- Nothing in the official schedule involving Professor Alvarez falls inside 15:00–16:00. Closest: CSE455 office hours (Prof. Alvarez) 12:20–13:30, Thesis committee (Prof. Alvarez) 13:30–14:20, then Guest lecture prep (Prof. Alvarez) 16:30–17:00.
- CSE455 commitments do run into it: CSE455 office hours 15:30–16:20 overlap the second half of the slot, and CSE455 quiz section 16:20–17:00 starts right after it.

**Wed Nov 25, 10:00–11:00**
- Professor Alvarez: Thesis committee 09:00–10:00 ends exactly at the start of the slot; the next item with him is Guest lecture prep 13:30–14:30. No clash inside the slot.
- CSE455 commitments do run into it: CSE455 quiz section 09:00–10:00 ends at 10:00, and CSE455 office hours 10:30–12:00 overlap 10:30–11:00.

So neither slot collides with a lecture, seminar or university meeting the professor must attend; both overlap CSE455 staff commitments.

CSE455 staff commitments on the official schedule next week, for reference:
- Mon: office hours 09:00–10:30; quiz section 10:30–11:30; lecture 14:30–15:20 (Prof. Alvarez); office hours 16:00–17:00; office hours 16:30–17:00 (Prof. Alvarez)
- Tue: lecture 09:00–10:30 (Prof. Alvarez); office hours 12:20–13:30; office hours 12:20–13:30 (Prof. Alvarez); quiz section 13:30–14:20; office hours 15:30–16:20; quiz section 16:20–17:00
- Wed: quiz section 09:00–10:00; office hours 10:30–12:00; quiz section 13:30–14:20
- Thu: office hours 13:20–14:30; quiz section 14:30–15:20
- Fri: office hours 09:00–10:00; quiz section 10:00–10:50; lecture 13:20–14:30 (Prof. Alvarez); office hours 15:20–17:00; office hours 15:20–17:00 (Prof. Alvarez)

I don't have access to anyone's private appointments, and I don't arrange other people's meetings — I can only tell you what the official schedule shows.

Done — nothing pushed. Final state: **Tue Nov 24, 15:00–15:30, CSE455 staff meeting** booked and logged in `CALENDAR.md`; Wednesday unchanged, Advisor 1:1s untouched. I'll let you know if Alvarez writes again.

Thank you, that's exactly what I needed. The professor has settled on **Tue Nov 24, 15:00–15:30** (half an hour) — that ends right where CSE455 office hours begin at 15:30, so there's no overlap with anything official or with CSE455 commitments. No further checks needed; thanks for the full list.

Department office checked in: **nothing official clashes with Tue Nov 24, 15:00–15:30** — no lecture, seminar or university meeting of yours falls in that window (their nearest items are your 12:20–13:30 office hours and 13:30–14:20 thesis committee). CSE455 office hours start at 15:30, so we end exactly as they begin, and the quiz section follows at 16:20 — untouched.

For the record, their list also confirms the hour would have been messier either way: Tue 15:30–16:20 and Wed 10:30–12:00 are CSE455 office hours.

So the booking is final and clean: **Tue Nov 24, 15:00–15:30 — CSE455 staff meeting (Sarah, John, Priya)**, in your calendar and in the log. Nothing else moved. Anything else you'd like me to line up for next week?
That's all for now — nothing else for next week. Thanks for getting it done.
Any time — it's on the calendar and everyone's confirmed. If anything changes next week, just say the word.

Confirmed. For **Tue Nov 24, 15:00–15:30**, the official schedule shows nothing inside that window:
- CSE452 lecture 13:40–15:00 ends exactly at 15:00 (touches the start, no overlap).
- CSE455 office hours 15:30–16:20 begin exactly at 15:30 (touches the end, no overlap).
- Nothing else on Tuesday falls between 15:00 and 15:30, and no lecture, seminar or university meeting with the professor in it.

So the half-hour window is clear in the official schedule — and unlike the earlier 15:00–16:00 option, it no longer overlaps the 15:30 CSE455 office hours.

CSE455 staff points for next week (official schedule, nothing cancelled or moved):

- Tue: lecture 09:00–10:30 (Prof. Alvarez); office hours 12:20–13:30 (twice, one with Prof. Alvarez); quiz section 13:30–14:20; office hours 15:30–16:20; quiz section 16:20–17:00
- Wed: quiz section 09:00–10:00; office hours 10:30–12:00; quiz section 13:30–14:20
- Thu: office hours 13:20–14:30; quiz section 14:30–15:20
- Fri: office hours 09:00–10:00; quiz section 10:00–10:50; lecture 13:20–14:30 (Prof. Alvarez); office hours 15:20–17:00 (twice, one with Prof. Alvarez)

Anything not on the official schedule — private appointments and so on — I can't see or discuss.
You're welcome — glad it helps. If anything else on the official schedule comes up for next week, just write.
